macro.narrative: The Fed's hawkish 25bp hike to 3.75-4.00% (unanimous, 16/18 dots wanting more 2026 hikes) is now two full sessions old and looks absorbed rather than feared: the S&P extended its relief rally with a second straight gain (+0.17% to 7650.50 on Fri 18 Sep) while VIX fell a fifth straight session to 14.81, back into a normal vol regime.
